# markdown-badges-collection

> Copy-paste Shields.io badges for GitHub README and profile: tech, framework and tool badges with official brand colors and logos from Simple Icons and devicon.

This catalog has 311 badges in 15 categories. Each badge is a static Shields.io badge: `https://img.shields.io/badge/<Name>-<HEX>?logo=<simple-icons-slug>&logoColor=<white|black>`. Badges whose logo is missing from Simple Icons embed a single-color SVG from devicon as a base64 data URI instead.

## Resources
- [Searchable catalog](https://pawang-ai.github.io/markdown-badges-collection/): browse, filter and copy badges
- [badges.json](https://pawang-ai.github.io/markdown-badges-collection/badges.json): machine-readable list of all badges
- [README (English)](https://github.com/pawang-ai/markdown-badges-collection/blob/main/README.md)
- [README (Bahasa Indonesia)](https://github.com/pawang-ai/markdown-badges-collection/blob/main/README.id.md)
